title: Baja Craft Beer Hope from San Diego

blurb: If you already do brewery hopping why not do border hopping? Or better, why don’t you do both? Tijuana it's a perfect city to this activity. While you get a taste of the great craft beer on Tijuana you will get to see were the inspiration of this amazing beer is coming from.
